context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 74 fixed a critical bug in team.py where the _get_syndic function was using user.get('id') instead of user.get('_id'). The get_current_user() function returns the user with _id (string), not id. This caused POST /api/team/members to fail with 'Impossible de determiner le syndic parent'. The fix was simple: change user.get('id') to user.get('_id') on lines 54-59. All Team API endpoints now work correctly. The TeamSection component is properly integrated into MonBureauPage and displays the team management UI.
